$description: Loading motion (library plan wave 2, foundation loading-motion): the timing of the three loading animations, the spinner's turn, the skeleton's shimmer and the indeterminate progress run, and the delay before an indicator shows. system/motion.css draws them (plx-motion-spin, plx-motion-shimmer, plx-motion-progress); with reduced motion each one stands still.

motion-loading-spin-duration.$description: Spinner: one full turn. A steady loop, never faster.

motion-loading-spin-easing.$description: Spinner: an even speed all the way round (no ease in or out, which reads as a stutter).

motion-loading-shimmer-duration.$description: Skeleton: one sweep of the shimmer across the placeholder.

motion-loading-progress-duration.$description: Indeterminate progress: one run of the fill from the start of the track to its end.

motion-loading-delay.$description: The wait before a loading indicator appears, half a second, so a fast answer never flashes it (plx-motion-delayed on its wrapper).

motion-loading-region-delay.$description: The wait before a region loading state (LoadingState, Spinner delay="region") appears, one second, so a fast load shows nothing (D-0130, ADR 0042). Not motion: the reduced-motion file never sets it to 0. Controls keep motion-loading-delay.

motion-loading-long-delay.$description: The wait after which a region loading state adds a second line ("This is taking longer than usual.") and, with onCancel, a Cancel button: ten seconds, the standard response-time step (D-0158, ADR 0051). A wait, not motion: the reduced-motion file never sets it to 0.
